attributes.name: interp
attributes.digest: Specify the interpolation mode
attributes.description: Specify the interpolation mode: "none" and "step" perform no interpolation, "linear" performs two-point linear interpolation, "cosine" performs two-point cosine interpolation, "cubic" performs four-point cubic interpolation, "spline" performs four-point Catmull-Rom spline interpolation, and "spline6" performs six-point (5th order) B-spline interpolation.
